name: The Pebble of Kajaro
label: Quest
description: The Pebble of Kajaro: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hakkari fear you, friend. They speak of horrors they believed that only their faceless God could perpetrate. You have burned them with the force of Kajaro. They now know fear in two places.
It is time to further strengthen the pebble. Hand me the talisman.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Continue in your decimation of the trolls of Zul'Gurub. Hakkar must see that the world will not buckle beneath his indomitable will.
